interpretation.plain_speak: This is the first clean resource-law break in this series. Once action authority can disappear mid-run, the starting budget is no longer enough to predict outcomes. Recomputing what can actually still be delivered—and by when—restores exact prediction.
interpretation.next_stage: test revoke-then-restore budget schedules to determine whether dynamic reachable amount and coverage summarize the availability path or whether resource history itself matters
